name: Che hat sen
summary: Lotus-seed sweet soup, fragrant with coconut milk.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 December 2025 article lists it with chè bắp and chè đậu xanh.
howToEat: Order a bowl after the meal.
seoTitle: Che hat sen — lotus-seed sweet soup in Hoi An
seoDescription: Chè hạt sen in Hoi An is a lotus-seed sweet soup fragrant with coconut milk.
